newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran says holding "Iraqi agent" for 1994 bombing.
newsitem.headline: Iran says holding "Iraqi agent" for 1994 bombing.

text.p: Iranian police have arrested a man on charges of being an Iraqi agent and carrying out a 1994 bombing in Tehran in which two people died, a newspaper said on Tuesday.

The daily Ettelaat quoted Gholamhossein Rahbarpour, head of Tehran Revolutionary Courts, as saying the man was also accused of bombing oil pipelines in southwestern Iran and soon would be put on trial. He gave no further details.
After the November 1994 bombing Iran accused the Iraq-based Mujahideen Khalq armed opposition group of carrying out the attack. The group denied the charge.
Tehran and Baghdad, which fought a war from 1980 to 1988, often trade charges of sabotage and terrorism.
